summary: Ukrainian long-range drones struck major Russian oil refineries in Omsk, Nizhnekamsk, and Saratov, plus military-industrial facilities in Bryansk, Crimea, and Donbas. Russian missile and drone attacks on Kyiv on July 6 and July 7-8 killed 19 civilians and injured 61, with further strikes causing fires and casualties in multiple districts. Ukraine received a significant Canadian air defense package, while Japanese aviation fuel sanctions and Romanian admission of a Ukrainian drone in Constanta port highlight expanding international dimensions.
key_points: Ukrainian drones hit Omsk refinery (largest, 22M tons/year) at 2500+ km range, flying ~3000 km. (Source: @UkraineNow/82483)
Ukrainian drones struck Nizhnekamsk refinery in Tatarstan, 1100+ km from border. (Source: @eRadarrua/100263)
Ukrainian drones attacked Saratov "Krekyng" refinery and Borisoglebsk in Voronezh region. (Source: @eRadarrua/100258)
Ukrainian defense struck two Russian weapons plants in Bryansk, Belgorod airfield fuel depot, two Crimea railway bridges, and Donbas materiel depots. (Source: @UkraineNow/82462)
Russian massive strike on Kyiv night of July 6 killed 19 (1 child), injured 61 (7 children); search and rescue completed July 7. (Source: @UkraineNow/82463)
Russian night attack July 7-8 hit Kyiv's Desnyansky and Svyatoshynsky districts, injuring 2, damaging admin building, tram depot, garage cooperative. (Source: @UkraineNow/82486)
Russian attack on Odesa hospitalized 5 (1 critical), ballistic threat from south persists. (Source: @UkraineNow/82482)
Ukraine received significant Canadian air defense package with more en route per Zelensky. (Source: @UkraineNow/82473)

sections.executive_summary: Ukrainian long-range drones conducted unprecedented deep strikes against Russian energy and military-industrial infrastructure, hitting refineries in Omsk, Nizhnekamsk, and Saratov at distances over 2,500 km. Russian forces responded with massive combined missile and drone attacks on Kyiv across two nights, killing 19 civilians and injuring 61, followed by a ballistic missile strike on Odesa. International dimensions expanded with Canadian air defense deliveries, Japanese fuel sanctions, and Romanian confirmation of a Ukrainian drone incident in a NATO member's port.

points: Ukrainian long-range drones conducted deepest strikes to date, hitting Omsk refinery (22M tons/year capacity) at ~3000 km flight distance, Nizhnekamsk refinery (1100+ km from border), Saratov "Krekyng" refinery and Borisoglebsk facility. (Source: @UkraineNow/82483, @eRadarrua/100263, @eRadarrua/100258)

Ukrainian defense forces struck military-industrial targets: "Gruppa Kremniy EL" electronics plant in Bryansk (components for control, EW, weapons), Bryansk chemical plant in Seltso (gunpowder, explosives, rocket fuel), Belgorod airfield fuel depot, two railway bridges in Crimea, and materiel depots in Donbas. (Source: @UkraineNow/82462)

Ukrainian naval drones destroyed eight Russian shadow fleet tankers, a bulk carrier, and a ferry in the Sea of Azov, which were transporting sanctioned fuel to occupied Crimea. (Source: @UkraineNow/82467)
Ukraine's "North" military group claimed control of Petro-Ivanovka village in Kharkiv region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31443)
President Zelensky confirmed receipt of a significant Canadian air defense package with additional supplies en route. (Source: @UkraineNow/82473)

Russian forces launched a massive combined missile and drone attack on Kyiv on the night of July 6, resulting in 19 deaths (including 1 child) and 61 injuries (including 7 children), with search and rescue operations concluding on July 7. (Source: @UkraineNow/82463)

A subsequent Russian night attack on July 7-8 struck Kyiv's Desnyansky and Svyatoshynsky districts, causing fires in an administrative building, tram depot, and garage cooperative, injuring two civilians (one hospitalized). (Source: @UkraineNow/82486)
Russian forces attacked Odesa with ballistic missiles, hospitalizing five people (one in critical condition), while a ballistic threat from the south remains active. (Source: @UkraineNow/82482)
Russian air defense reported drone danger over Yaroslavl region, blocking movement towards Moscow. (Source: @tass_agency/384267)
Russian drone struck a gas station in Kharkiv's Shevchenkivskyi district. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31436)
